abstract.t: This document introduces a new top-level TLV in IS-IS, the Originating Generation Identifier (OGID) TLV, which is carried in every Link State PDU (LSP) fragment originated by a node. The OGID identifies the logical transaction to which a set of LSP fragment updates belongs. When accompanied by a Fragment Count greater than one, it additionally allows a receiving node to determine when all fragments participating in that transaction have been received. This enables receivers to process multi-fragment updates atomically, avoiding the transient Link State Database (LSDB) inconsistencies that can otherwise occur when logically related LSP fragment updates are flooded and processed independently.
